description: 園管局楠梓科技產業園區污水下水道使用管理規章 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部產業園區管理局. 目的及方式：依據下水道法第十九條第一項規定，使用、管理及維護楠梓園區下水道排水區域內之下水及廠商。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部產業園區管理局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
